The '''Boonta scrapyard''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] junkyard located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. The rickety [[Proto Droid]] [[Proto One]] was the proprietor in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''[[Sand Sloth]]'' crash-landed in the scrapyard, and Proto One fixed it for its owner, [[Kea Moll]].
